description:
Reactive if= mount/unmount (§17.1). A click runs toggle() flipping @open false->true; the if=@open

mounts. ! is boolean negation (not = absence, E-TYPE-045). The whole-tree dom is the semantic tree (button + mounted panel); the normalizer drops impl#1's private empty
rationale: §17.1 reactive if= on a markup element mounts/unmounts the subtree as its boolean cell flips. A user click drives the flip through the wired handler. The whole-tree dom asserts the semantic tree — the button and the mounted panel, nothing impl-private (impl#1's empty <template> if-guard anchor is dissolved by the normalizer, README OQ1); anchored mode asserts only on the author's #panel. The count:0-at-seed companion assertion lives in the sibling if-top-level-absent case (this case ends in the true/present state, so the false-state absence can only be pinned where @open stays false).
